how_a_probe_record_is_identified: by the fingerprints the harness itself writes -- the condition id shape, the slug prefix and the payout event -- NEVER by the experiment id, which is the defect being audited

environment.where_every_run_happened: the local PostgreSQL 16 cluster inside this session's container, at 127.0.0.1:5432. Every probe invocation was given an explicit --dsn on that loopback address
how_that_is_known: the probe takes a --dsn and has no default that could resolve to production; every invocation in this session passed a 127.0.0.1:5432 DSN
no workflow invokes tools.bettor_capacity_probe, so it never ran on a runner that holds the production DATABASE_URL secret (grep of .github/workflows returns nothing)
this container has no egress to the production database or API host, which is why every production read in this session goes through a GitHub Actions runner

the same audit is run against production's own DATABASE_URL on the runner, read-only, as part of the release readback -- see the step named `Capacity probe -- the isolation audit, against production` in .github/workflows/command-verify.yml
environment.appeared_in_strategy_inventory_exposure_: NO, in any database: the probe wrote no external_valuations row (0 in every database audited), so no calibration sample and no valuation-driven consumer could see it; and the positions it wrote existed only in the four disposable databases below, none of which any deployed service reads

correction.what_was_wrong: the writer phases stamped EXT_PINNACLE_DEVIG_V1_SHADOW -- the autonomous strategy's own experiment id -- on every synthetic plan, so 2,080 of the 2,249 probe positions sat in the book that means real decisions
correction.method: the four affected databases hold NOTHING BUT probe records (probe positions equal total positions in each), and they are disposable local scratch databases, so the correction is to REBUILD them from the repository's migrations rather than to delete rows. Nothing was deleted by experiment id and no genuine row was touched anywhere

before_the_first_write: a strategy experiment is refused by name (REFUSED_A_STRATEGY_EXPERIMENT)
the database must be chosen explicitly with --confirm-disposable DO (REFUSED_THE_DATABASE_WAS_NOT_CONFIRMED_DISPOSABLE)
a database holding any position under a strategy experiment is refused (REFUSED_THE_DATABASE_HOLDS_A_STRATEGY_BOOK)
guards_added.per_run_identity: every row a run writes carries that run's id in its payout event, and the two harness experiments are its only books
guards_added.ui_filtering_is_not_the_boundary: these are refusals in the harness before any write, and a regression pins them
